claims.evidence: YAMAHA logo clearly visible on body in photos 0, 1, and 2; 'professional' tier/model cannot be confirmed as no model number is visible.
All three photos show 'YAMAHA' printed on the body; no Casio branding appears anywhere in the report.

risks.risk: Seller's own statements conflict on basic identity (claims Yamaha, then claims Casio), suggesting a copy-pasted or mismatched listing.
risks.proof: A fresh, unedited photo/video of the full unit with seller holding a handwritten note with today's date, showing the brand and any model plate clearly.
risks.if_unproven: treat listing as unreliable; price at worst case for an unbranded/unverified-model keyboard, not as a premium Yamaha model

risks.risk: No model number visible, so exact market tier and feature set (number of keys, voices, touch-sensitivity) unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model label, usually on the back or near the power input.

risks.risk: Functionality of keys, buttons, display, and speakers not demonstrated.
risks.proof: Short video of the keyboard powering on, playing a scale across the full key range, and demonstrating speaker sound.

risks.risk: Power adapter, pedal, or stand not shown as included.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together with the keyboard.

risks.risk: Back/underside condition (cracks, battery compartment, missing screws) not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of the rear and underside of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: price assuming possible hidden cosmetic/structural damage

risks.risk: Watermark 'LUCKY SOUNDS SERVICES LTD' suggests images may be sourced from a third-party reseller or stock photo rather than the actual item in seller's possession.
risks.proof: New photos taken by the seller without the watermark, in current setting, with a timestamp or identifying marker.
risks.if_unproven: treat as possible stock/reused images; price at worst case and flag for re-verification before payment

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model number/label (usually on the back or near the power jack).
Video of the keyboard powering on and playing across all keys with audible sound.
Photo of the rear and underside of the unit.
Photo of all accessories (adapter, pedal, stand) included in the sale.
A fresh, unwatermarked photo/video confirming the seller currently has physical possession of this exact unit.
response.reason: The seller's own words directly contradict each other and contradict the photographic evidence (claiming Casio while the unit is clearly branded Yamaha), and watermarked images raise doubt about whether the photos even depict the seller's actual item.
